name: PostSider: Create a Draft With an Image

parameters.content:
## Draft with an image from a URL
Set **Channel Names or IDs** in the PostSider node and run the workflow. Media is set to **Public URLs** and When to **Draft**, so the image is imported into the PostSider media library and attached to a draft that is not published.

The URL must be public, use HTTPS and end in a lowercase `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.webp`, `.mp4`, `.webm` or `.mov`. Replace the example URL with your own file.

The API key needs the scopes `posts:write`, `channels:read` and `media:write`.

parameters.text: A review-first draft created from n8n.
